newsitem.title: USA: Senate OKs spending for Commerce, Justice and State.
newsitem.headline: Senate OKs spending for Commerce, Justice and State.

text.p: The Senate Tuesday overwhelmingly passed, 99-0, a $31.6 billion spending bill for the Commerce, Justice and State Departments for fiscal 1998.

The bill includes funds for a variety of agencies in the three federal departments, ranging from the Federal Bureau of Investigations to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. It also funds the federal court system.
It includes $5.1 billion for the State Department, including contributions for United Nations organisations and international peacekeeping.
It also includes a $6.2 million recommendation for the Supreme Court's buildings and grounds, a down payment on a renovation needed there.
A similar bill is pending in the House.
